items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: Battistellas, and those other people, had those great big tables, and shrimp were piled up on, and fish, and everything, and fruits, and vegetables.

ctx.x: Then? Did you go to, Decatur Street in the 50's? I don't remember,

never heard music on Decatur Street. You know, Decatur Street in the 50's, the French market was, you know, it was a real fish market, and Battistellas, and those other people, had those great big tables, and shrimp were piled up on, and fish, and everything, and fruits, and vegetables. And, but I, don't remember, ever going to music, on Decatur Street. I may have missed, it completely.
